scope: The historic Paleis-Raadhuis at Willemsplein 1, Tilburg, as photographed in 2010, including the crenellated palace, four round turrets, west entrance canopy and east projecting bay.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The national register identifies the 1847–49 plastered palace, round corner turrets, long-side projections and pointed windows installed during the 1930s renovation.
The architects identify the separately constructed city-office building and its link to the palace.
BAG/AHN roof elevations provide independent height controls for the main roof and turret decks.
